commands.name: generate
commands.description:
Synthesize Speech
Returns a url to the generated audio file along with other associated properties.

options.name: --audio-duration
options.description: This parameter allows specifying the duration (in seconds) for the generated audio. If the value is 0, this parameter will be ignored. Only available for Gen2 model.

options.name: --channel-type
options.description: Valid values: STEREO, MONO

options.name: --encode-as-base64
options.description: Set to true to receive audio in response as a Base64 encoded string instead of a url. This enables zero retention of audio data on Murf's servers. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --format
options.description: Format of the generated audio file. Valid values: MP3, WAV, FLAC, ALAW, ULAW, PCM, OGG

options.name: --model-version
options.description: Valid values: GEN2. Audio will be generated using the new and advanced GEN2 model. Outputs from GEN2 sound more natural and high-quality compared to earlier models.

options.name: --multi-native-locale
options.description:
This field is superseded by `locale` field. Please migrate to `locale` field to ensure compatibility with future API versions.
Specifies the language for the generated audio, enabling a voice to speak in multiple languages natively. Only available in the Gen2 model.
Valid values: "en-US", "en-UK", "es-ES", etc. Use the GET /v1/speech/voices endpoint to retrieve the list of available voices and languages.

options.name: --locale
options.description:
Specifies the language for the generated audio, enabling a voice to speak in multiple languages natively. Only available in the Gen2 model.
Valid values: "en-US", "en-UK", "es-ES", etc. Use the GET /v1/speech/voices endpoint to retrieve the list of available voices and languages.

options.description: Pitch of the voiceover

options.name: --pronunciation-dictionary
--rate
options.description: Speed of the voiceover

options.name: --style
options.description: The voice style to be used for voiceover generation.

options.name: --text
options.description: The text that is to be synthesised. e.g. 'Hello there [pause 1s] friend'

options.name: --variation
options.description: Higher values will add more variation in terms of Pause, Pitch, and Speed to the voice. Only available for Gen2 model.

options.name: --voice-id
options.description: Use the GET /v1/speech/voices API to find supported voiceIds. You can use either the voiceId (e.g. en-US-natalie) or just the voice actor's name (e.g. natalie).

options.name: --word-durations-as-original-text
options.description: If set to true, the word durations in response will return words as the original input text. (English only) Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

commands.name: stream
commands.description:
Stream Speech
Synthesize speech with ultra-low latency over a streaming connection.
Choose the `Base URL` from the URL dropdown (Global URL or a pinned Region)

**Note**: Global URL auto-routes to the nearest region.
| Region         | URL                                       | Default Concurrency |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| Global (Routes to the nearest server) | `https://global.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`     | Region specific concurrency |
| US-East                   | `https://us-east.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`    | 15 |
| US-West                   | `https://us-west.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`    | 2 |
| India                     | `https://in.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| Canada                    | `https://ca.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| South Korea               | `https://kr.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| UAE                       | `https://me.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| Japan                     | `https://jp.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| Australia                 | `https://au.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| EU (Central)              | `https://eu-central.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream` | 2 |
| UK                        | `https://uk.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`         | 2 |
| South America (São Paulo) | `https://sa-east.api.murf.ai/v1/speech/stream`    | 2 |

options.name: --pitch
options.description: Pitch of the voiceover

options.name: --pronunciation-dictionary
options.description:
A JSON string that defines custom pronunciations for specific words or phrases. Each key is a word or phrase, and its value is an object with `type` and `pronunciation`.
Example 1: '{"live": {"type": "IPA", "pronunciation": "laɪv"}}'
Example 2: '{"2022": {"type": "SAY_AS", "pronunciation": "twenty twenty two"}}'

options.name: --rate
options.description: Speed of the voiceover

options.name: --retain-accent
options.description: Set to true to retain the original accent of the speaker during voice generation. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --retain-prosody
options.description: Indicates whether to retain the original prosody (intonation, rhythm, and stress) of the input voice in the generated output. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --return-transcription
options.description: Set to true to include a textual transcription of the generated audio in the response. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --style
options.description: The voice style to be used for voiceover generation.

options.name: --transcription
options.description: This parameter allows specifying a transcription of the audio clip, which will then be used as input for the voice changer
